description: This file defines configuration constants, functions, and data structures related to QWEN models, including URLs, model catalog, and utility functions for model definition and URL support checks.

methods.name: isNativeQwenBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if the provided URL is a native QWEN base URL using support detection.

methods.name: applyQwenNativeStreamingUsageCompat
methods.description: Applies native streaming usage compatibility settings to a given provider configuration.

methods.name: buildQwenModelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs a model definition object based on provided parameters, filling in defaults from the catalog.

methods.name: buildQwenDefaultModelDefinition
methods.description: Builds the default QWEN model definition.
